source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The old nsImapOfflineSync constructor sets m_mailboxupdatesFinished=false. The extracted downloader stops calling that base constructor, declares its own plain bool without an initializer and initializes only window/listener in its constructor. ProcessNextOperation reads the flag before reaching the assignment at the end of mailbox updates. The accepted header later adds {false}; that later repair must not be credited to the original extraction. This is an exact static initialization finding, without a fresh sanitizer, build or crash result.
title: The downloader extraction loses a phase flag's inherited initialization before a later repair
